symptoms: In `case ":$PATH:" in`, patterns `"$NVM_DIR/current/bin:"*` and `"$HOME/.local/bin:"*` omit the leading colon. Because `":$PATH:"` starts with a colon, the patterns never match and always fall through to prepending, duplicating paths on repeated sourcing. Prefix with a colon (`":$NVM_DIR/current/bin:"*` and `":$HOME/.local/bin:"*`).
